versions.short: The bill would designate the Endless Mountains National Heritage Area in Pennsylvania as part of the National Heritage Area System, covering Bradford, Sullivan, Susquehanna, and Wyoming Counties along with any portions of other Pennsylvania counties identified in a feasibility study, with boundaries to be set by the Secretary of the Interior based on that study. The Endless Mountains Heritage Region, Inc. would serve as the local coordinating entity for the area. The local coordinating entity would be required to submit a proposed management plan for the area to the Secretary of the Interior for approval within 3 years of enactment. The Secretary's authority to provide assistance for the area would end 15 years after enactment.
